integrity.analytical_argument: Finite-dimensional Lyapunov identity and spectral-gap decomposition, with explicit nondegeneracy conditions.
integrity.verification: Exact-rational substitution and independent Gaussian elimination for selected spectra; universal claim relies on the displayed proof, not finite sampling.

scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional Hermitian one-excitation dynamics; the flat-spectrum identity requires pairwise distinct eigenvalues and equal local spectral weights.
The absorber has a single Markovian no-jump loss channel and the initial state is maximally mixed; no dephasing or competing recombination is included.
The cube singular limits apply for fixed dimension, not uniformly as the number of vertices tends to infinity.
The calculation establishes no many-body or finite-temperature behavior, no full capture-time distribution, and no independently certified historical priority.
title: Inverse-gap capture law and singular anisotropy in quantum hypercubes
